meta.name: pr
meta.description: Use when writing a PR body.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码改动整理成条理清晰的合并请求说明
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次写 PR 描述都纠结从哪下笔。
copy.tagline_en: Turn your code changes into a clear pull request description
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you stall every time you sit down to describe a pull request.

howto.what: 写 PR 描述时,Claude 按固定模板产出三段:Summary(用伪代码、文件树、Mermaid 或 diff 呈现改动)、Evidence(改前改后的截图/输出/测试)、Merge Danger(单向或双向门与影响范围)。
howto.when: 当你撰写 PR 描述(PR body)时触发,它会接管正文的写法:跳过前言、用简短文字配图示,并沿用 CONTEXT.md 里的领域用语。

say.text: 帮我按模板写这个 PR 的 body
用组件树和 diff 说明这次改动
say.note: 放在 Summary 里的可视化图示

say.text: 这个改动是单向门还是双向门?
say.note: 写入 Merge Danger 的门类型与影响范围

howto.what_en: When writing a PR body, Claude uses a fixed template with three sections: Summary (pseudocode, trees, Mermaid, or diff), Evidence (before/after screenshots, output, tests), and Merge Danger (one-way or two-way door, blast radius).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you write a PR body. Claude then drafts the Summary, Evidence, and Merge Danger sections, uses your domain language from CONTEXT.md, and skips preambles.

say_en.text: Write the PR body for this change using the template.
Show this change as a component tree and a diff.
Is this a one-way or two-way door?
say_en.note: Fills Merge Danger and blast radius
